The Phone APIs are now documented, so I can retrieve the stored Phone password and authenticate with the supplied phone number.

```python
phone_password = next(item['password'] for item in account_passwords if item['account_name'] == 'phone')
phone_login = apis.phone.login(username='3379617841', password=phone_password)
phone_access_token = phone_login['access_token']
print('Phone login successful')
```
